policy: A guest entry indexes the principles reviewed from that speaker. It is a reading of a public transcript, never an endorsement, never a claim that the speaker validated a persona, a product or a finding. A persona informed by these principles is never named after the guest and never speaks as them.
source_note: reported viewpoint from a podcast transcript; not endorsement, not proof of competence

categories.title: Positioning and marketing
categories.description: Naming the alternative a buyer actually considers, and saying why the product is different.

categories.title: Product discovery and research
categories.description: Turning an outcome into a justified feature choice through continuous customer contact.

categories.title: Product leadership
categories.description: Covering the risks a product proposal carries across value, usability, feasibility and viability.

categories.title: Engineering leadership
categories.description: Writing an engineering strategy people can act on, and holding a technical standard.

categories.title: AI and ML products
categories.description: Evaluating AI systems on their weak cases rather than their demos.

categories.title: Design leadership
categories.description: Connecting observed behaviour to design options, and reconciling data with what users say.

categories.title: SaaS and go-to-market
categories.description: Matching the commercial motion to how the buyer wants to buy, and defending retention.

categories.title: Hardware and product building
categories.description: Making coupled physical and software components usable as one thing.

categories.title: Communication and presenting
categories.description: Structuring an update, an answer, or a practice loop so the audience can act.

categories.title: Management and feedback
categories.description: Making feedback a dialogue about specific behaviour rather than a verdict about a person.

categories.title: Operations and scaling
categories.description: Giving a growing organisation a cadence and written decisions it can rely on.

categories.title: Investing and market timing
categories.description: Judging durable usage and market change rather than market size alone.

categories.title: Executive hiring and org design
categories.description: Hiring for the stage the company is in rather than for prestige.
